dataset.name: Chandra Estates - fictional demo property dataset
dataset.numbering: Indian digit grouping (lakh / crore), e.g. ₹75,00,000 and ₹1,25,00,000
dataset.dataDisclaimer: Fictional sample property for website demonstration only. Not a real property. Not offered for sale or rent. Not available for viewing.
dataset.demoNotice: Fictional sample — property, location, price and photographs are illustrative only. Not for sale or rent; not available for viewing.
dataset.priceNotice: All prices are fictional illustrative examples for a demo website. They are not market valuations, not offers, and were not converted from any other currency.
dataset.listingTypeNotice: listingType is null on every record: nothing here is offered for sale or rent. Use availability ('not-available') and priceType ('illustrative') instead.
dataset.locationNotice: City and district names are real Indian places used as sample locations. Every locality name, plot number and address below is invented. This does not imply that Chandra Estates operates in those cities.
dataset.pinCodeNotice: pinCode is null on every record because no verified postal code exists for a fictional address.
dataset.imageNotice: All photographs are stock images used as illustrative demo images. They do not depict the property described. Alt text is deliberately generic and every detail gallery is captioned 'Illustrative demo image - not an actual property photograph.'
dataset.areaNote: area is a convenience mirror of the category's primary area figure: builtUpArea for houses, carpetArea for apartments, plotArea for land and landArea for farmhouses. areaBasis states which.
dataset.maintenanceNote: maintenanceCharges is in INR per month. maintenanceCurrency and maintenancePeriod make this explicit on every apartment record.
dataset.plotAreaUnitNote: plotAreaUnit is the unit for a house's plotArea (the plot the house stands on). It is 'sq yd' on every house record.
dataset.yearBuiltNote: yearBuilt values are fictional examples only; they are not verified construction years.
dataset.categoryFields: Category-specific fields appear only on records of that category; all records share the same common fields.
dataset.source: index.html - const properties (kept in sync with this file)
dataset.syncNote: index.html carries an identical copy of these records in its JavaScript array; the site does not fetch this JSON yet.
notes: Prices are numeric INR values; priceDisplay uses Indian grouping and always matches the numeric price. All prices are illustrative, not offers or valuations.
Every record is marked isDemo true, dataStatus 'demo', status 'demo-only', availability 'not-available' and priceType 'illustrative'.
listingType is null on every record because nothing here is offered for sale or rent.
No record has an address, PIN code, ownership detail, survey number, approval or RERA registration that can be verified. Those attachments are deliberately absent.
address values are prefixed 'Fictional address:' so they cannot be mistaken for real locations.
approvalStatus is null on every plot; no approval or legality is claimed.
Photographs are stock images used as illustrative demo images. They do not depict the property described; detail galleries are captioned and alt text is generic.
Land records use only their own photograph plus the shared category image; no land gallery shows another property's photograph.
featured is true on exactly three records, matching the three slots in the homepage featured grid.
The website still reads the JavaScript array in index.html; properties.json is a synchronised export and is not fetched by the site.
